readout_other: optical intrinsic signal imaging (HbR); LFP theta/gamma relative power and sample entropy; neurovascular coupling by Pearson correlation
direction_notes: TUS before forepaw stimulation increased the HbR response peak and shortened its peak time in AD mice toward healthy values, and lowered theta relative power and neurovascular coupling strength.

exposures.label: TUS to left hippocampus in APP/PS1 mice
